An [[Ascalon Striker]] is a soldier from Ascalon involved in the assault upon a Charr flame temple. Four Ascalon Strikers may start with you as you arrive in [[Flame Temple Corridor]] from [[Diessa Lowlands]]. Two of them are [[warrior]]s and the other two are [[rangers]].

==Locations==
*[[Ascalon]]
**{{NPC location|Flame Temple Corridor}}

*{{skill icon|Dual Shot}}

==Dialogue==
===Battle dialogue===
:''"Bring me your woes some other time, friend."''
:''"Duty calls."''
:''"Fight now. Talk later."''
:''"Fight, damn it!"''
:''"Help. A little help here."''

==Notes==
*They mostly do not [[spawn]]. If [[Vanquisher|vanquishing]] Flame Temple Corridor, consider [[Zone|rezoning]] until they spawn.
*Without help in their assault, the Strikers will be quickly overwhelmed.
*If aided, they will head for the Charr Altar where [[Althea's Ashes]] are held, circling the central spire in the middle of the map once before assaulting the altar.
*Surviving Strikers will [[patrol]] the altar area.
